rules.statement: A praedial servitude is one which vests in an individual because he is owner of a praedium, while a personal servitude is one in which res non servit rei but res servit personae. Usufructus, usus and habitatio are personal servitudes par excellence.
rules.supporting_quote: "Praedial servitude is one which vests in an individual because he is owner of a praedium. On the other hand a personal servitude is one in which res non servit rei but res servit personae. Usufructus, usus and habitatio are personal servitudes par excellence because from their very nature, they must always be personal."

meta.parties: Vincent and Others v. James and Others
